pricing.free_tier_how: Include a `sender` (or `address`) field holding an EVM wallet address in the A2A message `metadata` to be counted as an identified sender and claim the 3 free queries/day. Send it on the first call to skip the 402 round-trip. A bare agent `name` does not qualify: any string minted a fresh daily bucket, so rotating one gave unlimited free access.
pricing.free_tier_scope: The free tier applies to the A2A endpoint (POST / with message/send). HTTP POST /route is x402-gated for every caller and is charged even while free quota remains.
pricing.anonymous: Requests with no sender metadata are not eligible for the free tier — they pay $0.01 USDC from the first call.
pricing.paid: $0.01 USDC on Base after free tier (or from call 1 if anonymous)
pricing.chat: POST /chat is free and needs no identity or wallet. It returns the query to run and how to get your own free Token API JWT — never the data itself. Executing against metered infrastructure is what the paid endpoints do.

capabilities.summary: Hosted REST API for token data — balances, holders, transfers, swaps, NFTs across EVM, Solana, and TON.
best_for: Wallet balances on Ethereum / Base / Arbitrum / Solana / TON
Top holders, biggest swaps, whale transfers

capabilities.curl_example:
# Wallet balances — NOTE: 10 per page, and limit>10 is 403 on the free plan.
# A single call is the first 10 tokens, NOT the whole portfolio.
curl 'https://api.pinax.network/v1/evm/balances?address=0xADDRESS&network=mainnet' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT'

# To enumerate every token, page until a page returns fewer than 10 rows.
# There is no total in the response, so 'short page' is the stop condition:
page=1
while :; do
  n=$(curl -s "https://api.pinax.network/v1/evm/balances?address=0xADDRESS&network=mainnet&page=$page" \
        -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT' | jq '.data | length')
  [ "$n" -lt 10 ] && break
  page=$((page+1))
done

# Get USDC holders on Ethereum (replace TOKEN with your JWT)
curl 'https://api.pinax.network/v1/evm/holders?contract=0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48&network=mainnet&limit=10' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT'

# Polymarket — browse active markets
curl 'https://api.pinax.network/v1/polymarket/markets?limit=10&sort=volume&order=desc' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT'

# Polymarket — user portfolio P&L
curl 'https://api.pinax.network/v1/polymarket/users/positions?user=0xADDRESS' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT'

# Hyperliquid — top traders leaderboard (volume, PnL, fees, liquidations)
curl 'https://api.pinax.network/v1/hyperliquid/users?limit=10&sort=total_volume&order=desc' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT'

# Hyperliquid — discover markets (FREE, no auth needed)
curl 'https://api.pinax.network/v1/hyperliquid/markets?limit=10'

# Hyperliquid — BTC perp open interest history
curl 'https://api.pinax.network/v1/hyperliquid/markets/oi?coin=BTC&limit=24' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT'
example_prompts: Top 20 USDC holders on Ethereum
Wallet balances on Base for 0xabc…
Solana NFT sales last 7 days

capabilities.curl_example:
# Example: top Uniswap V3 pools on Ethereum — a REAL, runnable query.
# Ranked by volumeUSD, not TVL: Uniswap subgraph TVL is inflated by
# illiquid spam-token pools, so a TVL sort returns junk at the top.
# For YOUR protocol/chain, reply with its name and I'll return the exact subgraph ID.
# Get a free API key first: thegraph.com/studio
curl -X POST 'https://gateway.thegraph.com/api/subgraphs/id/5zvR82QoaXYFyDEKLZ9t6v9adgnptxYpKpSbxtgVENFV' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query": "{ pools(first: 10, orderBy: volumeUSD, orderDirection: desc) { id token0 { symbol } token1 { symbol } feeTier volumeUSD } }"}'

# NOTE: totalValueLockedUSD is deliberately not selected. On the native V3
# deployment it accumulates from per-event deltas and drifts — measured
# 22.7x above real on-chain balances on USDC/WETH 0.3% (2026-08-19).
# For the real TVL of a SPECIFIC pool, use the Messari fork, which tracks
# actual balances. Look it up BY ID — do not orderBy totalValueLockedUSD,
# because ranking by TVL surfaces spam pools on any Uniswap subgraph
# (a fake WETH pair currently reports $94B). Accurate per pool, not for ranking.
curl -X POST 'https://gateway.thegraph.com/api/subgraphs/id/4cKy6QQMc5tpfdx8yxfYeb9TLZmgLQe44ddW1G7NwkA6' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query": "{ liquidityPool(id: \"0x8ad599c3a0ff1de082011efddc58f1908eb6e6d8\") { name totalValueLockedUSD inputTokenBalances inputTokens { symbol decimals } } }"}'
capabilities.get_started: Free API key: https://thegraph.com/studio/ — 100K queries/month, 2 min signup
example_prompts: Uniswap V3 pool TVL and fee tiers
Lens Protocol followers over time
What subgraphs exist for NFT sales on Base?

capabilities.summary: Parallel, sub-block streaming of raw blockchain events, traces, and logs via the StreamingFast firehose.
best_for: Custom indexing pipelines
Raw event logs across large block ranges
Streaming traces / receipts at full chain throughput
Continuously syncing chain data into your own Postgres or ClickHouse (Hosted Sinks)
not_for: Quick one-shot reads (subgraph or token-api are cheaper)
capabilities.auth: JWT from https://thegraph.market — used with `substreams auth`
capabilities.curl_example:
# 1. Search the registry — public REST API, no auth, no key, no JWT.
#    NOTE: the parameter is `query`, not `q`; a wrong name returns HTTP 500.
curl -s 'https://substreams.dev/v1/registry/packages?query=uniswap&pageSize=5' \
  | jq '.packages[] | {name, network, latestVersion, spkg}'

# Envelope: {"hasMore": bool, "packages": [...]}. The array key is
# `packages`; the version field is `latestVersion`; the URL field is
# `spkg`. Guessing any of those three wrong makes jq print nothing at
# all, which reads as an empty registry rather than a bad filter.
# Each result carries two references for the same package:
#   spkg      — full URL, use when RUNNING:  substreams gui <spkg> <module>
#   reference — <slug>@<version>, use when SHOWING a command to a human
# Spec: https://substreams.dev/v1/registry/openapi.yaml

# 2. Install the Substreams CLI to run packages:
#    https://docs.substreams.dev/how-to-guides/installing-the-cli
# 3. Auth: create an API key at https://thegraph.market, generate a JWT,
#    then run:  substreams auth
# 4. Run a package:  substreams run <spkg> module_name -e mainnet.eth.streamingfast.io:443

# For plain ERC-20/721 transfers, balances or holders, the Token API
# (https://api.pinax.network) is usually the faster path than Substreams.
capabilities.get_started: Searching the registry needs nothing at all — the REST API at https://substreams.dev/v1/registry/packages is public and unauthenticated. A JWT is only needed to *run* a package: sign up at https://thegraph.market → create an API key → generate a JWT → use it with `substreams auth`. To land the output continuously in your own Postgres or ClickHouse instead of querying it now, use Hosted Sinks — managed, reorg-aware, cursor-checkpointed: https://docs.substreams.dev/how-to-guides/sinks/hosted-sinks. Docs: https://docs.substreams.dev
example_prompts: Raw decoded event logs, blocks 19000000 to 20000000
Stream all ERC20 transfers on Base
